seriesData.description:
Map of series names to array of data points. Each data point is represented by a number. The data array
is aligned with the timestamps array.

timestamps.description:
An array of stringified timestamps based on the interval and duration
of the model validation chart.

eventData.description: Map of events and alerts. The key is 'event' or 'alert'.

thresholds.description: Map of model output/input names to their respective thresholds

maskConfig.description: The data configuration to use to plot the masks as EChart mark areas.

columnGroups.description:
The column groups to plot in the chart. Each column group is a list of strings that correspond
to keys in the seriesData map.

featureToColumnGroups.description:
A map of feature names to column groups. When a feature is selected in the ui, its column groups
will be plotted.

preparationInterval.description: The interval used to determine whether the interval options should be displayed in the UI.

title: This type stores all the data that will be shown in the Model Validation Chart in the UI.
name: ModelValidationChartData
